mapper.select: SELECT b.SPIC_EMPNO AS empno, a.SR_NO AS srNo, a.SR_REG_STAT_CODE AS statusCode, a.SR_TPCD AS srTpcd, a.RFLC_SCDL_DATE AS rflcScdlDate, a.TITL_CNTT AS titlCntt, a.MSG_CNTT AS msgCntt, NVL(SUM(TO_NUMBER(TRIM(b.JOB_EXEC_HOUR))), 0) AS jobHours, NVL(SUM(TO_NUMBER(TRIM(b.JOB_MANM))), 0) AS jobMm, 'Y' AS planYn FROM TBCPPE091M00 a INNER JOIN TBCPPE093L00 b ON a.SR_NO = b.SR_NO WHERE b.APRV_YN = 'Y' AND a.SR_REG_STAT_CODE NOT IN ('00','02','07','08','09','16','97','22','18') AND a.SR_TPCD NOT IN ('15') AND b.SPIC_EMPNO IN #{e} GROUP BY b.SPIC_EMPNO, a.SR_NO, a.SR_REG_STAT_CODE, a.SR_TPCD, a.RFLC_SCDL_DATE, a.TITL_CNTT, a.MSG_CNTT UNION ALL SELECT a.PRCH_EMPNO AS empno, a.SR_NO AS srNo, a.SR_REG_STAT_CODE AS statusCode, a.SR_TPCD AS srTpcd, CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR2(8)) AS rflcScdlDate, a.TITL_CNTT AS titlCntt, a.MSG_CNTT AS msgCntt, 0 AS jobHours, 0 AS jobMm, 'N' AS planYn FROM TBCPPE091M00 a WHERE a.SR_REG_STAT_CODE = '02' AND a.SR_TPCD NOT IN ('15') AND a.PRCH_EMPNO IN #{e} ORDER BY statusCode, srNo
